% Fallback definitions for evaluation-number macros used in the paper before
% data/eval/eval_numbers.tex (generated by the evaluation pipeline) exists or
% defines them. Each \providecommand below only takes effect if the macro is
% not already defined, so once eval_numbers.tex is generated and inputted
% first (see main.tex), its real values win and these placeholders are
% no-ops.
%
% Later tasks: if you introduce a new evaluation macro that is referenced in
% the paper before eval_numbers.tex defines it, append a \providecommand for
% it here so the build keeps passing.
